goal: Emergency switches for AI features (analysis CO-01, AD-10; Owner chose the table plus Admin buttons on 2026-10-31): a public.ai_feature_switches table with one row per feature, an ai.manage RPC that requires a reason and writes the admin audit log, a Switches panel in Admin AI Studio, server checks in ai-council, ai-persona-chat and ai-astrology-insight that answer 503 feature_paused, and app copy that says the feature is resting. Until the migration is applied the functions treat a missing table as on. The migration joins the Singapore packet; the packet hash must be recomputed and step 2a re-approved.
successCriteria: Admin with ai.manage can turn a feature off or on with a reason; ai.read can view states.
A paused feature returns 503 feature_paused before any model call and uses no turn.
The app shows a resting message instead of a fallback answer.
A missing table or read error leaves features on.
Deno, admin and mobile tests pass.
untouchedSurfaces: No SQL is run and nothing is deployed in this change; both wait for Owner approval with the Singapore packet.
Tarot and Daily keep running without a switch check for now.
